A tidy-up of the whole panel after the UI audit. Nothing about how servers run has changed.

On phones, server cards fit the screen, Start, Restart and Stop sit in a **Power** menu, and the server tabs become a menu. The System page is split into five sections: Overview, Updates, Off-site storage, Notifications, and Account and security. Settings and Game settings show a **Discard** and **Save** bar while you have unsaved changes, **Export world** has moved to the World tab, and release notes like these are shown formatted in the panel. Pages share one width and style, dates and times follow your locale, and the Console **Address** card shows the server's hostname.

Testing notes are under **UI pass** in [testing-1.1.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.1.0-beta.3/docs/testing-1.1.0.md).
